name: kodhama
description: The kodhama marketplace — one install door for the stewards: trellis (governance), grove (agent swarm), wisp (runtime observability), spore (session drivers).

plugins.name: trellis
plugins.description: Install and consult Trellis in a Claude Code project: the invariants, expressed at your strength.

plugins.name: grove
plugins.description: Compose the grove agent swarm onto your project: twelve chartered gardener roles, placeholders filled interactively via /grove:setup.

plugins.name: wisp
plugins.description: Agent runtime observability through a self-contained MCP server for Claude and Codex.

plugins.name: spore
plugins.description: Session-driver skills for Claude Code — spawn, hot-fork, and tend Remote-Control sessions & plugins from the side (macOS). Loads spore:<skill> skills; install via /plugin install spore@kodhama.
